item.title: SRTC names former Valdosta BOE chair its first business and industry relationship manager
item.description: Southern Regional Technical College recently named Kelly Wilson as the college's first business and industry relationship manager.

item.description: VALDOSTA — Bush Wealth Management recently announced that Kent Patrick has been named managing partner. Previously serving as partner and wealth advisor, Patrick will now oversee the firm’s strategic direction […]

item.title: SGMC Health introduces PET cardiac stress testing for more accurate heart diagnostics
item.description: SGMC Health is expanding its advanced cardiac imaging capabilities with the introduction of Positron Emission Tomography (PET) cardiac stress testing, offering patients faster, more accurate assessments of heart function close to home.

item.title: U.S. News & World Report lists VSU among the best for online learning
item.description: U.S. News & World Report has listed Valdosta State University among the nation’s best colleges and universities when it comes to distance education.

item.title: Lakeland man sentenced on gun charge
item.description: A South Georgia man with prior assault and drug convictions was sentenced to prison after police found him with a stolen gun following a traffic stop and car crash.

item.title: Warming shelters seek volunteers
item.description: Greater Valdosta United Way has sent out a call for volunteers to help at warming shelters in Lowndes and Lanier counties.

item.title: Rep. Dexter Sharper charged with fraud
item.description: A third Georgia state lawmaker was charged Friday with unemployment fraud in a pandemic-era safety net program.

item.title: Presentation fundraiser leads push to replace historic church windows
item.description: First Antioch Missionary Baptist Church raised $350 in donations during a historical presentation and fundraiser on Jan. 20, as well as a $2,500 donation from Historic Valdosta, to replace the church’s broken windows.
